notes:
Deal summary: Late-stage procurement; final decision: AWS SageMaker managed endpoints.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-01-10: Intro call (AE Jordan) — high interest in chat + embeddings for fraud ops.
- 2025-01-22: Deep technical demo (SE Priya) — ran sample workload, showed batching and quantization tradeoffs (Fireflies ff_2025_01_22_8345).
- 2025-01-30: Security review kickoff — asked for SOC2 + KMS integration and VPC peering.
- 2025-02-07: Pricing review — procurement pushed back on uplift vs. hyperscaler credits. Shared pricing deck (drive:/decks/aegle-redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf).
- 2025-02-10: Final exec call — CTO said, quote: "We need vendor consolidation and to leverage our AWS enterprise discount." (Fireflies ff_2025_02_10_1273).
- 2025-02-14: AE follow-up; received email thread confirming AWS decision (gthread_final_decision_aegle_2025feb).

Decision factors / notes from eval:
- Primary reason for loss: internal procurement + finance favored using existing AWS enterprise agreement and SageMaker Endpoints — lower apparent operational overhead.
- Security team: preferred managed cloud-native endpoints to reduce third-party surface area; AWS offered controls + internal KMS integration they trust.
- Budget: mid-Q1 budget freeze reduced willingness to sign multi-year reserved capacity. AWS credits and consolidation argued as cost-optimal.
- People: initial internal champion (Lead ML Eng) left the company during procurement window — no replacement to drive a multi-vendor effort.

What we pitched vs. why it lost:
- Redwood strengths emphasized: lower per-token cost at scale with batching + private/VPC option, rollout tooling, predictable latency SLAs.
- Hyperscaler advantage: one vendor for infra + existing discounting, simpler procurement, perceived lower integration surface for security.

Next actions / follow-up recommendations (internal):
- Mark account closed-lost; tag reason = lost_to_hyperscaler_managed_endpoints.
- Save POC artifacts and notes to account folder; set 6-9 month re-touch cadence in CRM.
- Send short ROI/benchmark summary to procurement contact for future re-open if they reconsider multi-cloud or dedicated requirements.

Stated blocker list (echoed by buyer): budget freeze, no internal champion, and vendor consolidation mandate.

Misc: Jira issues opened during POC: INF-4821 (integration question), SEC-2198 (data residency Qs).

CRM-style single-line summary: "Procurement: lost to AWS SageMaker endpoints — procurement + security favored cloud-native consolidation; budget freeze + champion left; archive and re-touch in 6-9 months."
